judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Short, plain greetings fit Nox's shopkeepers, but the lines lean on a mining-town theme too uniformly and 'Word gets around... hex the beard off your chin' is a punchier, more crafted quip than Westwood's flatter shop chatter, with an unexplained hostility that feels set up for effect.
